desc: Make tethered smokes self-verifying so an agent can judge them without the maintainer at the panel. Today every B0-family pass criterion is a panel observation because the proven bootargs use console=tty0 only, so the kernel's own dmesg never reaches the KIS pty — in the ticket-147 log there is no 'Kernel command line', no page-size line, and no driver output, only what userspace echoed. That is why 147 needed an attended session and why a screenshot was required to disprove a wrong-object run. Task: build a DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY object variant adding ttydc0 as a second console (e.g. console=tty0 console=ttydc0, or earlycon) so dmesg is captured in the chainload log, and confirm the userspace health report still appears. KEEP the proven console=tty0-only bootargs for enrollment and acceptance runs — this variant is for diagnosis, and its bootargs differ from the proven 3659a0da set, so results from it must be labelled as such. Pairs with 151 (a self-verifying harness needs both a correct verdict and readable evidence).
author: claude
result: 2026-07-26 OBJECT BUILT + strict-verify PASS, awaiting a rig smoke. m1n1-b0-dwm-fat-diag.bin d14df9f3 (83,197,952 B = 5078 x 16 KiB, kernel pages=4K). Byte-identical to the fat graphical object c5438779 in every member; ONLY the bootargs differ, adding console=ttydc0 (hash 68198332, deliberately not the proven 3659a0da). Transport checked, not assumed: the DTB's serial node (compatible apple,dockchannel-serial) has no status property so it defaults to enabled, there is no stdout-path in chosen so console=ttydc0 is what selects it, the parent node has apple,poll-mode (the live-proven conservative path), and KIS can observe ttydc0 — it is the USB gadget that cannot, and this smoke is over KIS. EXPECT a slow boot from two compounding costs (67 MiB single-threaded xz, then ignore_loglevel pushing full dmesg over a POLLED console); ignore_loglevel was kept on purpose since detail is the point. /dev/console becomes the last console= (ttydc0), but the inittab spawns its getty on tty1 explicitly and X uses startx -- vt1 -keeptty, so the panel session is unaffected. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: results must be labelled as such and acceptance runs keep m1n1-b0-dwm-fat.bin. Paired with ticket 151's verdict logic this makes a graphical smoke self-verifying. Evidence: done/2026-07-26-t6040-diagnostic-dual-console-object.md. | 2026-07-26 ROOT-CAUSED, OBJECT INERT. The diagnostic object d14df9f3 cannot work as designed: the shipping drivers/tty/apple_dockchannel_tty.c is a TTY ONLY — no register_console, no struct console, no CON_* — so console=ttydc0 matches no registered console and is silently ignored, and no kernel dmesg reaches the host. That is why the 17:31 run's console log stopped dead at handoff. /dev/ttydc0 does exist, which is why a USERSPACE getty works and how the 147 B0 health report reached the host (scripts/t6040-b0-ttydc0-console). The patch that WOULD add a real console, patches/t6040-dockchannel-nbcon.patch (register_console, CON_PRINTBUFFER|CON_NBCON, name 'ttydc', index id), is never referenced by t6040-kbuild.sh and has never been applied — same for t6040-dockchannel-atomic-tx.patch. AGENT ERROR ACKNOWLEDGED: the DTB node and the console name inside an unapplied patch were both verified, but not that the shipping driver registers a console. ALSO A CORRECTION: the duplicated dmesg and ghosted glyphs on the panel were attributed to two CON_PRINTBUFFER registrations, which is impossible since ttydc0 never registers — it is the single normal fbcon-handover replay ('Console: switching to colour frame buffer device') plus fbcon written from replay and live-printk contexts, so it will appear on the plain object too. NEXT: apply the orphaned nbcon patch (now that 159 makes its target file tracked), rebuild, and re-cut the diagnostic object; earlycon is the alternative but also orphaned and needs an explicit earlycon= arg. Until then the PANEL is the only source of kernel dmesg and a screenshot remains necessary evidence for any graphical smoke.
note: 2026-07-26: the diagnostic object d14df9f3 is invalid for TWO independent reasons — console=ttydc0 matches no registered console (the shipping driver is a TTY only, ticket 159), AND its initramfs expands to 278.9 MiB so m1n1 cannot decode it at all (ticket 160). Any re-cut must use a rootfs under the 128 MiB guard and needs the nbcon patch applied first.
